cues.text:
Before the dawn, beneath the stone
They thought that hope had died alone

But morning found an open grave
And news of One who rose to save

The place where Jesus once had lain
Could never hold Him bound again

The stone was moved, the night was through
And living hope was born anew

The night gives way
The morning breaks

Jesus lives
And hope awakes

Risen Son, You conquered night
Jesus Christ, our living Light

Death could never hold You down
Life and victory are Yours now

The grave is empty
My hope is alive

Jesus, my Savior
In You I will rise

Your wounded hands still bear the sign
Of love that gave its life for mine

The scars remain, but death is past
You rose to give us life that lasts

When fear returns and shadows grow
Your risen life is what I know

You are the hope that will remain
The living Christ who broke the chain
